xi_reconstruction_failure_modes.description: Failure modes specifically for the reconstruction operator Xi.

failure_modes.name: clipping_induced_preimage_loss
failure_modes.description: Xi fails to recover state information lost during Pi_A projection at the threshold boundary.

failure_modes.name: aggregation_induced_causal_erasure
failure_modes.description: Xi cannot distinguish between distinct path histories that yield the same aggregate NavT flux.

failure_modes.name: branch_explosion_reconstruction_failure
failure_modes.description: Xi fails to bound the set of admissible preimages due to unpruned branching in delta.

failure_modes.name: observable_underdetermination
failure_modes.description: Selected metrics provide insufficient constraints for Xi to isolate a valid preimage set.
